Name: Alex's Pumpkin Patch
Author: xBrince
Description:
[size=5][b]Pumpkin Patch[/b][/size]
[i]More pumpkins. So many more pumpkins.[/i]

[b][color=#ff9900]AI DISCLOSURE:[/color] [/b]I want to be completely transparent.[b] This mod is 100% AI-generated.[/b] Every sprite, every line of code and all of the text was made by an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic) from my ideas and direction. I did not draw the art or hand-write the code. I understand many people do not like this which is exactly why I want to normalize full disclosures. I still think you should try my mods as they came from a place of love :). But nothing from the base game or from other mods is included in the download. Feel free to use parts of it in your own work (see [b]Permissions[/b] below), just don't claim you made the assets or code yourself.

[line]
[center]NOW INTEGRATED WITH MY OTHER MOD: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53395] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53395]Alex's String Lights at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] [/center]
[center]NOW WITH PUMPKIN CARVING!  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53524]Alex's Pumpkin Carving (Pumpkin Patch Add-on) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url][/center]

[size=4][b]What it adds[/b][/size]
Everything is added [i]alongside[/i] vanilla. Nothing is replaced, and it is safe to add to an existing save.

[list]
[*][b]11 new pumpkin crops[/b] with their own colors and sizes: Mini Pumpkin, Baby Boo, Ghost Pumpkin, Porcelain Doll, Jarrahdale, Fairytale, Cinderella, Knucklehead, Black Futsu, Carnival and Atlantic Giant. Fall crops, sold as seeds at Pierre's.[/*]
[*][b]Trellis minis[/b]: Mini Pumpkins and Baby Boos grow on a trellis and regrow, giving 2 to 4 pumpkins per harvest.[/*]
[*][b]Pumpkin Seed Mix[/b]: a mystery seed packet that grows a random pumpkin (vanilla or modded).[/*]
[*][b]Giant pumpkins[/b]: Atlantic Giant, Ghost Pumpkin and Jarrahdale can grow into 3x3 giants.[/*]
[*][b]Placeable pumpkin props[/b]: a decoration for every pumpkin type (minis and Baby Boos make a cute little cluster), plus harvest props from Robin: pumpkin stack, crate of minis, corn shock, basket of boos, hay bale, pumpkin pile and a pumpkin wagon.[/*]
[*][b]8 carved jack-o'-lanterns[/b] that light up at night, each made from a different pumpkin, plus a Jack-O'-Lantern Stack and a Lantern Hay Bale at Pierre's booth at the Spirit's Eve festival. Glow strength is configurable.[/*]
[*][b]Artisan goods[/b]: Pumpkin Butter (Preserves Jar) and Pumpkin Ale (Keg) for every new pumpkin, or switch to vanilla Pickles and Juice in the config.[/*]
[*][b]9 recipes[/b]: 7 pumpkin dishes from Gus at the Saloon, plus Pumpkin Pie and Pumpkin Soup made with Mini Pumpkins.[/*]
[*][b]A secret side quest[/b]: there is something extra hiding in the giant pumpkin patch. It isn't marked anywhere in game, so keep an eye on your giants, your mailbox and the fall festivals, or open the spoiler below.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Where to get things[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Seeds and Seed Mix: Pierre, fall only (Atlantic Giant seeds are rare and come from the Traveling Cart).[/*]
[*]Pumpkin decorations and jack-o'-lanterns: crafting recipes, learned automatically when fall begins.[/*]
[*]Large harvest props: Robin.[/*]
[*]Dish recipes: Gus.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][b]Secret side quest walkthrough (spoilers!)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Break a fully grown giant Atlantic Giant pumpkin to get a very rare Giant Pumpkin Seed. It is the only source, and Mayor Lewis will send you a letter about it.[/*]
[*]Optional: age the seed in a cask (about 4 weeks to iridium quality) and show it in your grange display.[/*]
[*]At the Stardew Valley Fair (Fall 16), trade it at the star token booth for a Prize-Winning Seed.[/*]
[*]Craft the Prize Pumpkin prop from the Prize-Winning Seed (the recipe is learned automatically in fall). You can then carve it, with torches, into a Giant Jack-o'-Lantern.[/*]
[*]Or plant the Giant Pumpkin Seed like a fruit tree sapling instead. The Giant Pumpkin Tree fruits Atlantic Giants in fall, which you can feed into a Seed Maker for a steady supply of seeds.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

The README included in the download covers everything else (it also contains the spoilers above, so skip it if you want to find the secrets yourself).

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Content Patcher (2.9 or newer)[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: Item Extensions, needed for the Seed Mix randomness and the jack-o'-lantern glow. Without it the mod still works, the Seed Mix just grows a regular pumpkin and the jacks don't emit light.[/*]
[*]Optional: Alternative Textures and the optional download on this page, for an extra cosmetic variant of one of the props.[/*]
[*]Optional: Alex's String Lights 0.8.0 or newer, for the Glow Jacks. [/*]
[*]Optional: Alex's Pumpkin Carving, to carve your own face into an Atlantic Giant (see Companion mods).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip the [b][CP] Pumpkin Patch[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. Recipes arrive on the first morning of fall (or the next morning if you add the mod after fall has started).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Options live in [b]config.json[/b] (created on first launch) or in Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*][b]ArtisanGoods[/b]: Original (Butter and Ale, default) or Vanilla (normal Pickles and Juice).[/*]
[*][b]JackGlow[/b]: Off, Faint (default), Dim or Bright. Jack-o'-lanterns are meant to be soft, not street lamps.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Options live in [b]config.json[/b] (created on first launch) or in Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*][b]ArtisanGoods[/b]: Original (Butter and Ale, default) or Vanilla (normal Pickles and Juice).[/*]
[*][b]JackGlow[/b]: Off, Faint (default), Dim or Bright. Jack-o'-lanterns are meant to be soft, not street lamps.[/*]
[*][b]StringLights[/b]: Off (default) or On. On teaches the Glow Jack recipes when Alex's String Lights is installed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Everything is new items, so it should coexist with other crop and furniture mods. Pumpkin Patch only adds entries to shops, machines and a few other data files; it does not replace vanilla pumpkins. If you remove the mod, its items, crops and furniture will disappear from your save.

[size=4][b]Companion mods (all optional, same author)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Alex's Pumpkin Carving[/b]: craft a Carving Pumpkin from an Atlantic Giant and carve any face you like, pixel by pixel, in an in-game carving screen. 12 ready-made faces, undo, mirror, fill, night preview.[/*]
[*][b]Alex's String Lights[/b]: string lights, Christmas trees and a Light Manager Desk. Lights the Glow Jacks and your carved pumpkins with patterns.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
Because this mod is entirely AI-generated, I want it to stay honest and shareable. You are welcome to use, edit, translate or remix any part of it in your own mods, as long as you:
[list=1]
[*]Do [b]not[/b] claim you created the assets or code yourself, and say plainly that they are AI-generated.[/*]
[*]Credit it: "Pumpkin Patch by xBrince (AI-generated with Claude)" with a link back to this page.[/*]
[*]Do not re-upload the unmodified mod, and do not sell it or put it behind a paywall.[/*]
[/list]The full terms are in [b]LICENSE.txt[/b] in the download.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Direction, ideas, testing and publishing: xBrince. Art, code and text: Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant. Thanks to the SMAPI, Content Patcher, Alternative Textures and Item Extensions authors, whose tools make this kind of mod possible.

On a personal note, while this mod was made with AI, it was made with care and consideration. I don't want to post mod slop and sought to create a mod people would actually enjoy. I wanted to harmlessly add something that makes me happy, so I hope it brings you some happiness too. If you have any suggestions, questions, or problems please let me know. Happy spooky season!
